notes.text: The main pencil drawing consists of a sphere with three marked points, a bipyramid-like figure with retraced edges, and an open oval to its right. Relative positions, hollow centres and dark marks are retained in TikZ.

The small mark inside the right oval favors a radical with 1, while pi remains possible. The hooked lower-left stroke, sloping retraced bar and right upright support both forms; no definition or expected mathematical role resolves them.

The front-side printer block contains 32 identical rows, each reading GUTS OUTPUT FOR PREDONT DELIVER AT 0000 - PREDONT.MODULEF5. It is upside down relative to the pencil sketches and is set with that orientation. It is not the pale mirrored printing seen through other reused sheets.

The peripheral pale blue-gray oval groups are reverse-side impressions, not additional front drawings. Their broken contours differ from the continuous pencil strokes. The main reader independently established mirrored positional matches with drawings on the opposite side: the middle group with scan031 II1, the lower-left group with scan031 III2-prime right sphere, the upper groups with I4/I6, and the lower-middle group with III2-prime left sphere. Reader B did not open scan031.

Several lower pencil lines cross the dark printer text. These remain drawing overlaps; no printed word is treated as deleted or replaced. The independent tracing refines the approaching curves, gaps and irregular rings. At the crowded main lower junction no separate closed pencil ring is secure, so none is imposed. The distinct small loop farther down-left remains.
Foliation 31 is clear, but its hand is unassigned. H omits both this number and the printer block. No mathematical claim on the sheet was independently checked.

The main reader personally viewed both differing fixed crops in full. Both graphic readings were revised, with the neighboring printing and oval represented once in their own elements. Unsupported isolated specks and a pale disconnected horizontal were omitted. The sphere and all 32 complete printed rows remain unchanged. Native crop coordinates use translation only; absolute pt sizes and inherited width are scaled by .007/.02 for the right oval and .007/.012 for the central drawing. No mathematical check or TeX compilation was performed.
